title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Box Dimensions and Where Each Size Is Installed
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank offers its Safe Deposit Boxes in six sizes. The size name gives the face of the box in inches; every size shares the same depth. Not every branch vault has every size fitted.

## Interior dimensions

| Box size | Interior height (inches) | Interior width (inches) | Interior depth (inches) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 3 | 5 | 24 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 3 | 10 | 24 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 5 | 10 | 24 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 | 10 | 24 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 10 | 15 | 24 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 10 | 20 | 24 |

## Sizes installed at each branch vault

A mark of "installed" means the branch vault has boxes of that size; "not installed" means that size does not exist at that branch.

| Branch | 3x5 | 3x10 | 5x10 | 10x10 | 10x15 | 10x20 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Greensboro Main Office | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed |
| Winston-Salem Reynolda Road | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed |
| Charlotte SouthPark | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed |
| Raleigh North Hills | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | not installed |
| Greenville Main Street | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | not installed |
| Roanoke Market Square | installed | installed | installed | installed | not installed | not installed |

## Reading the tables

- The four smallest sizes, from the 3x5 through the 10x10, are fitted in all six branch vaults.
- The 10x15 Safe Deposit Box is fitted everywhere except Roanoke Market Square.
- The 10x20 Safe Deposit Box, the largest, is fitted only at Greensboro Main Office, Winston-Salem Reynolda Road and Charlotte SouthPark.
- Moving from the 3x10 to the 5x10 adds height while keeping the width; moving from the 10x10 to the 10x15 or 10x20 adds width while keeping the height.
